Good evening,

I hope you are doing well.

We would like to kindly inform you that the property owner has requested a brief viewing of the apartment on Thursday.

Would it be possible to arrange the viewing between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM? If this timing is convenient for you, kindly confirm so we can inform the owner and coordinate the visit accordingly.

The viewing will be brief and conducted with minimal disruption. We truly appreciate your kind cooperation, understanding, and support in accommodating this request.

Thank you.
